methodNotes: No school in this file has a verified Ontario percent-to-admission formula.90–100 placements must be explicitly editorial.
SAT middle-50 bounds describe past cohorts, not minimum requirements or admission probability.
For test-optional schools, a low SAT should not automatically exclude a strong transcript; a no-score route may be compared while honoring entry-cycle policy.
For required/expected-score schools, report below/within/above historical range without converting it to safety/match/reach certainty.
Do not fill10slots by calling weakly supported schools officially eligible. Research-candidate and official-component-match views are distinct.
